approval_contract.first_request: Preparation: implement and validate the proposed soft reference, reward bundle, metrics and matched schedule
training_requires: Explicit user approval of training, not merely preparation
Passing no-update safety, comfort, reference and reproducibility preflight
Resolved implemented configuration and measured preflight shown to the user
Fresh immutable source/config/policy hashes and readiness evidence
approval_contract.current_action: No learning or runtime reward changes are authorized by this proposal file

planning_sources.existing_teacher_result: Zero interventions and one stable merge, but maximum jerk 64.99989926815033 m/s^3; fails proposed nominal 5 m/s^3 gate

initialization.actor_for_each_arm: Exact same actor parameters; verify exported inference agrees before collection
initialization.critic_for_each_arm: Fresh identical 24-slot critic initialized from the same saved RNG state
initialization.optimizer_for_each_arm: Fresh identical optimizer state; no old PPO samples

environment_unchanged.safety_and_intervention_definitions: Unchanged; no filtering of counted native differences or safety events

network_treatment.scope: All training/validation references to this engineering network; all other network bytes unchanged

baseline_formulas.events: Existing event indicators and one-shot stability/reason-aware reversal semantics
baseline_formulas.reward_normalization: None; preserve active PPO advantage normalization separately

proposed_reward_overrides.missing_previous_sample: Skip the new residual term; do not fabricate reset/arrival or cross-vehicle history
proposed_reward_overrides.implementation_status: Not implemented; requires review and no-update validation

proposed_reference.inputs: Current 99 actor fields only, including measured native acceleration; no future state or native diagnostic getters
proposed_reference.entry_distance_floor: 4.5 m only if current projected front/rear gaps satisfy unchanged safety checks; otherwise 0.1 m
proposed_reference.soft_speed: min(existing legal-speed-buffer, current following/target-lane reference, ending-lane taper, active preview-entry speed)
proposed_reference.braking_priority: Mandatory braking overrides the nominal reference slew immediately; retain all jerk/safety measurements
proposed_reference.deployed_policy_effect: Supervisory/reward reference only, no added inference limiter or forced maneuver
proposed_reference.reference_ceiling: min(unchanged hard safety guard, observation-based native ACC/minor-entry response estimate); estimates are not exact feasibility or unsafe-request classifications
limitations: SUMO remains authoritative: 99 fields do not expose all native ACC mode history, farther leaders or junction interactions.
The 4.5 m preview floor can hold an approximately 6 m/s entry target too early; reject unnecessary slowdown through predeclared drawdown/travel gates.
Nominal reference slew does not guarantee native realized jerk; preserve and test all actual measurements.

optimizer_common.advantage_normalization: Mean/std over active PPO batch as currently implemented
optimizer_common.backend: CPU, one worker, one torch thread, deterministic algorithms

arms.reward: Proposed overrides with all other baseline weights retained
arms.coefficient_condition: Applies only to the new desired reference after preflight, never blindly to the existing v3 discontinuity

matched_schedule.construction: One predeclared deterministic train-only stratified sequence shared by both arms; persist exact rows and index before collection
matched_schedule.dense_following_definition: Difficulty 2, total 24; counted within following and difficulty-2 shares
matched_schedule.mastery_grade: Measured separately; exposure difficulty does not assert a mastery gate passed
matched_schedule.full_av_rule: Initial traffic only, excluding following/passing scripted-leader tasks
matched_schedule.shortfall_rule: Record actual per-stratum decisions and matched exposure differences at budget stop; never claim full factorial coverage

conditional_pilot_budget.initial_evaluation: One shared frozen initial actor evaluation over all 24 cases
conditional_pilot_budget.wall_budget_includes: Fresh launch verification, shared initial evaluation, collection, optimization, checkpointing, failures and both final evaluations
conditional_pilot_budget.learning_time_allocation: Split remaining time before the 900-second final reserve equally between arms after common preparation/initial-evaluation costs
conditional_pilot_budget.resume: Exact config/source/RNG/critic/optimizer/schedule and pending-reservation accounting; interrupted reservations stay charged
conditional_pilot_budget.extensions: None automatically; incomplete evaluation cannot pass

preflight_requirements.status: New reference and reward implementation pending; existing teacher failed peak jerk gate
preflight_requirements.fixtures: Predeclare train-only nominal cruise, dense following, passing and merge cases plus mandatory-braking boundary cases before executing
preflight_requirements.native_baseline_and_teachers: Compare native, existing teacher and new reference; no future-state or getFollowSpeed queries
preflight_requirements.frozen_actor_invariance: Changing only reward/reference version must preserve frozen-actor observations/actions/native poses
preflight_requirements.nominal_startup_handling: Report startup and steady samples separately and together; include startup in all-sample nominal peak gate
preflight_requirements.danger_handling: Mandatory braking must override soft comfort target immediately; report uncensored jerk even when nominal comfort ceiling is inapplicable
preflight_requirements.completed_trips: No nominal regression from fixed existing-teacher comparator
preflight_requirements.merge_slowdown_and_travel_time: Use all requested trips through the fixed horizon, including unfinished traffic; low intervention alone cannot pass a reference
preflight_requirements.loss_audit: Validate weighted term values, SI units, relative gradients, required-braking counterexamples and absence of hidden action limiting

evaluation.validation_matrix_source: All 24 rows from exact parent config, replacing only every original I-110 network reference with the corrected network
evaluation.all_warnings_and_stops: Audit every native warning line and all-car consecutive speed<0.1 m/s stops lasting at least 2 seconds
evaluation.merge_slowdown_definition: Maximum speed peak-to-later-trough loss in fixed first-junction-entry-minus-5s through settled-through-completion-plus-8s window; report ratio to preceding peak, timestamps, phase, limits and coverage
evaluation.incomplete_merge_windows: Pending/incomplete, never zero slowdown or successful merge inferred from truncation

comfort_comparison.total_stable_merges_passes_completed_tri: No regression relative to the trained control
comfort_comparison.nominal_window_designation: Resolve and freeze fixture/window identities before running; do not exclude adverse samples after seeing results

evaluation.interpretation: Matched combined-reference/reward/auxiliary-loss treatment; cannot attribute gains to individual terms; single training seed, no physical-comfort certification or held-out promotion
